ci_resource_contract.reclamation: When initially below floor, remove only fixed unused Android/.NET/Swift SDK trees on a disposable GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 VM; never user/self-hosted machines, Python toolcache, Docker or checkout contents
ci_resource_contract.measurement: Record initial/before/after df, disk usage, docker system df, SDK sizes/removal logs and command elapsed times; fail if final floor is not met
ci_resource_contract.claim_limit: The 35 GiB floor is a conservative planning threshold. Only actual Linux build proves sufficiency; cleanup availability/capacity is not asserted.

prose_handoff.normal_launch: Build image plato; run ./dockerrun.sh or ./dockerrun_gpu.sh from a checkout matching the image lock. Optional command args forward exactly; non-TTY use retains stdin without requesting a TTY.
prose_handoff.environment: Editable root project at /root/plato; uv-managed Python at /opt/plato/python and UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT/PATH at /opt/plato/.venv survive the host mount; default sync omits dev groups.
prose_handoff.persistence: Default root identity is preserved. Ordinary rootful Linux Docker can produce root-owned files in the writable checkout mount; mounted outputs persist after --rm. Container-only dependency changes are lost on exit.
prose_handoff.review_note: DEPLOY-PLAN-L1 stays a P3 documentation obligation; no UID redesign was introduced.
